submitted.rationale: XRD at Ba 0.19, 0.50 and 0.79 showed the same pattern (strong peak at Q≈2.78, weaker ones at 3.20, 4.54 and 5.33), so it did not separate phases across the line. I used the 3 merit measurements to sample the composition line. Index 29 (Ba 0.31) gave 1.99e-6 A. That beat Ba 0.19 (8.9e-7 A) and Ba 0.66 (≈0 A). The best measured composition is in the Ba ~0.3 region.

rejected.reason: Mn-rich (Ba 0.19): 8.9e-7 A, less than half of index 29
